entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oooh, a terminal! I should be able to[n]access all the slots in this area from here.

entries.speaker: Futaba

entries.en: Hm, the entrance to the slot area... and[n]somewhere back in the staff-only area...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess we'll just have to go looking[n]for them! Let's hurry up and get this[n]done fast!
